title: 第19章 杀唐宇神工心汲吞鬼神纹第20章 姐姐摘了面纱超好看
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
呼呼呼——！
呜咽的风雪呼啸，宛如鹅毛般，在冷簌的空气中翻滚、打转。
唐宇宛若一大团烂肉，瘫在了地上。
说是哀求饶命，可实际上却是在威胁。
身为唐氏家族子弟，他高高在上习惯了，哪怕求饶也带着分颐气指使。
在唐宇看来，老实本分的李浪，绝对不敢杀他！
然而，他看到那伫立风雪中，背脊宛如标枪直立，眼眸冰冷无波的李浪，言语愈发的无力，心头不禁生出几分不确定。
李浪没有过多的言语，甚至对唐宇的威胁，毫无表示。
也不需要什么表示。
若今日跪在地上求饶的是他李浪，唐宇会放过他吗？
而他若是于今日被唐宇害命，那李浪无法想象自己死去后，清清会遭逢什么样的下场……
原本相依为命的小家，将彻底崩溃！
呼——
李浪徐徐吐出一口气，心瞬息冷寂如磐石，五指一攥，射光了一轮箭矢的神弩加特林再度化作白色清气消失。
继而，手掌在心口一抹。
消失的神弩加特林，便又一次重新出现在他的手中，李浪脸色微微煞白，短时间内，多次利用神工之心，取放神弩加特林，对于他的精神产生了不小的消耗。
但李浪的眼眸炯炯明亮。
六根森然竹管遥遥对准了唐宇，内里三十六根弩箭重新上膛，蓄势待发，迸发毒蛇般的森然！
对一个死人，李浪连半句话都不想说。
这般冷酷的姿态。

让唐宇声音开始颤抖，伤口汩汩流淌鲜血，可是他却似乎顾不得疼痛，张嘴想要开始真正的求饶。
然而……
晚了。
李浪瞬息叩下扳机，神弩转轮变动，强大推进力将弩箭从竹筒之中强势推出，压缩空气发出的爆裂呜鸣！
三十六根弩箭，如深渊中的黑色水蛭，疯狂呼啸而出！
每一根俱是瞄准唐宇的脑袋。
噗噗噗——！
强大的力量，纷纷扎入了唐宇那戴着藤木面罩的头颅，然而，那藤木面罩具备强大的防御力量，使得木箭并未射穿面罩，只是带动他肥胖臃肿的身躯后仰，仰面倒在了雪地中。
唐宇开始挣扎，像是一头扭动挣扎，等待屠宰的猪。
李浪眸光一冷，瞬息转换角度，剩余的木箭，顿时精准的呼啸向唐宇的心脏。
噗噗噗！
锋锐的尖刺，贯穿发白的肥膘，继而漫入心口，撕裂心脏肌肉！
一蓬蓬鲜血炸起！
滚烫的血液，在冰冷的空气中散发着扭曲热流！
死了么……
这算是第一次杀人吧？
李浪却发现，自己的心中并无半点不舒服，或许，在这鬼神肆虐，朝不保夕的世界，他早就做好了杀与被杀的心理准备。
content_en:
Huhuhu——!
The whining wind and snow howled like goose feathers, rolling and swirling in the cold air.
Tang Yu was like a big ball of rotten meat, paralyzed on the ground.
He said he was begging for his life, but in fact he was threatening.
As a descendant of the Tang family, he was used to being aloof and commanding others even when he begged for mercy.
In Tang Yu's view, Li Lang, an honest man, would never dare to kill him!
However, when he saw Li Lang standing in the wind and snow, with his back as straight as a javelin and his cold eyes, his words became weaker and weaker, and he couldn't help but feel a little uncertain in his heart.
Li Lang didn't say much, and didn't even express any response to Tang Yu's threat.
No expression is needed.
If it was Li Lang who was kneeling on the ground begging for mercy today, would Tang Yu let him go?
And if he was killed by Tang Yu today, then Li Lang couldn't imagine what would happen to Qingqing after he died...
The small family that originally relied on each other will completely collapse!
Huh——
Li Lang exhaled slowly, his heart suddenly as cold as a rock, he clenched his fingers, and the Gatling, the divine crossbow that had fired a round of arrows, turned into white air and disappeared again.
Then, he touched his heart with his palm.
The disappeared divine crossbow Gatling reappeared in his hand again. Li Lang's face turned slightly pale. In a short period of time, he used the heart of divine craftsmanship many times to take and release the divine crossbow Gatling, which exerted a considerable drain on his energy.
But Li Lang's eyes were bright and bright.
Six eerie bamboo tubes were pointed at Tang Yu from a distance, and the thirty-six crossbow arrows inside were reloaded, ready to go, bursting out with a viper-like eeriness!
Li Lang didn't even want to say a word to a dead man.
Such a cold gesture.
Tang Yu's voice began to tremble, and blood flowed from the wound, but he seemed to ignore the pain and opened his mouth to truly beg for mercy.
However...
It's late.
Li Lang pressed the trigger in an instant, and the wheels of the divine crossbow changed. The strong propulsion force pushed the crossbow arrows out of the bamboo tube, and the compressed air made an explosive sound!
Thirty-six crossbow arrows, like black leeches in the abyss, roared out crazily!
Every root was aimed at Tang Yu's head.
Puff puff puff——!
Powerful forces pierced into Tang Yu's head wearing a vine mask. However, the vine mask had strong defensive power, so that the wooden arrows did not penetrate the mask, but only caused his fat and bloated body to fall back and fell on his back in the snow.
Tang Yu began to struggle, like a twisting and struggling pig waiting to be slaughtered.
Li Lang's eyes turned cold, he changed his angle instantly, and the remaining wooden arrows whizzed towards Tang Yu's heart with precision.
Puff puff puff!
The sharp spikes penetrated the white fat, then spread into the heart, tearing the heart muscles!
Puffs of blood exploded!
The hot blood exudes twisted heat in the cold air!
Are you dead...?
Is this the first time someone kills someone?
However, Li Lang found that he did not feel uncomfortable at all. Perhaps, in this world where ghosts and gods were raging and people were in danger, he had long been mentally prepared to kill and be killed.
